g.text: EXP-008: fixed predictor ablation, task utility and finite-action regret
Primary defined. Positive favors geometry; descriptive paired-block intervals. C: filled dt=.005, open dt=.01. T00-T11: all blocks.
Targets 7008/7008; previews 3456/3456. Collection 162.35 s (includes fit 0.08 s); prior map 140.54 s separately.
Oracle outcomes are evaluation cost. The same 18 previews feed each policy; no equal-total-cost or net-speedup claim.
